latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of biz-hospitality skill.

- Provides professional hospitality planning for business events and VIP visits.
- Generates reception plans, seating arrangements, dining coordination, and etiquette guidance.
- Supports input of guest information, visit purpose/duration, host details, cultural needs, and budget.
- Outputs comprehensive itineraries, gift suggestions, conversation topics, and follow-up plans.
- Designed for protocol compliance and cultural sensitivity in corporate settings.
